statement: Hon Hai (Foxconn) reported August 2026 consolidated sales of NT$921.77 billion, up 51.98 percent year on year, its best August ever, on AI-server demand.
why: Foxconn is the largest assembler of AI server racks, so its monthly sales are a near-real-time read on how many accelerator systems are actually shipping rather than merely being ordered.

impact.mechanism: Record AI-server assembly revenue implies sustained pull-through of merchant GPUs and the racks, networking and facilities needed to house them.

evidence.excerpt: soaring 51.98 percent from a year earlier

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet reporting company-released monthly sales; no filing-level primary source in this document.
